label: Darkvision
description: You can see in Dim Light within the specified range as if it were Bright Light, and in Darkness within that range as if it were Dim Light.

label: Blindsight
description: You can perceive your surroundings without relying on sight within the specified range. Blindsight can't perceive color or read writing.

label: Tremorsense
description: You can detect and pinpoint the origin of vibrations within the specified range, provided the source is in contact with the same ground or substance.

label: Truesight
description: You can see in normal and magical Darkness, see Invisible creatures and objects, automatically detect visual illusions and succeed on saves against them, and perceive the true form of a shape-changer or a creature transformed by magic.
